name: A H M Rezaul Karim
tagline: Trustworthy Health AI · Clinical NLP · Large Language Models
bio:
I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at **George Mason University**, advised by [Prof. Özlem Uzuner](https://www.gmu.edu/profiles/ouzuner). My research lies at the intersection of **Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, and Healthcare**, with a focus on making AI systems more reliable, interpretable, and useful in clinical settings.

I work with **large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multimodal AI** to bridge the gap between complex clinical data and actionable information. My research spans clinical information extraction, medical vision-language understanding, trustworthy AI, and healthcare data interoperability. I am particularly interested in developing AI systems that can ground their predictions in evidence rather than simply generate plausible answers.

Before joining George Mason, I earned my B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from the **Islamic University of Technology (IUT)**, where my research journey began with natural language processing for low-resource languages, particularly Bangla.

**What drives my research is a simple question: How can we build AI that healthcare professionals can genuinely trust?** I enjoy tackling that question from both theoretical and practical perspectives, turning research ideas into end-to-end systems that address real-world challenges.
